subject.title: [Feature]: Allow Codex harness configured app-server provider IDs

question: Should OpenClaw accept `plugins.entries.codex.config.appServer.providerIds` as the supported way for the Codex harness to claim custom Codex `model_providers`?
rationale: The source gap is real, but adding provider-routing config is a maintainer-owned config/API direction under the repository's compatibility policy.

options.title: Accept With Parser Fix
options.body: Keep the advanced allowlist only if the implementation reads it through the strict Codex config parser and covers malformed app-server config with regression tests.

options.title: Use Existing Runtime Policy
options.body: Decline the new field and require operators to stay on existing `openai/*`, `codex/*`, or provider/model `agentRuntime.id` paths.

options.title: Defer Provider Mapping Design
options.body: Pause the change until maintainers decide whether OpenClaw should derive claimable provider IDs from Codex config or another canonical source.

recommendation.title: Accept With Parser Fix
recommendation.body: Keep the advanced allowlist only if the implementation reads it through the strict Codex config parser and covers malformed app-server config with regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the Codex app-server harness and controls, making him the strongest history-based owner for this config-surface decision.
